svg.title: San Francisco: SoMa and Mission geographic reference
svg.desc: Actual active street centerlines from DataSF. North is up. Landmark pins and neighborhood labels are approximate, not boundaries. Road strokes are diagrammatic widths, not walkable surfaces.
svg.text: Real street geometry. No fictional blocks. Simulation design reference, not a navigation map.
Source: City and County of San Francisco / DataSF, Streets - Active and Retired (3psu-pn9h).
Retrieved 2026-09-08 · 2551 active segments · local geographic projection; north up.
Landmark pins / labels are approximate. No parcel, park boundary, road width or transit routing is implied.
